[FACT] User has been taking dance classes at a local studio for about 3 months.  
[CHANGE] User has noticed significant improvement in coordination and rhythm since starting dance classes.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking to improve flexibility.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended stretching exercises for dancers, including warm-up, upper body stretches, lower body stretches, split stretches, and additional tips.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a list of stretching exercises:  
- Warm-up (5-10 minutes): light cardio and dynamic movements like leg swings, arm circles, and torso twists.  
- Upper Body Stretches: Chest Stretch, Shoulder Rolls, Neck Stretch.  
- Lower Body Stretches: Quad Stretch, Hamstring Stretch, Hip Flexor Stretch, Calf Stretch.  
- Split Stretches: Front Split, Side Split.  
- Additional Tips: Hold each stretch for 30 seconds, breathe deeply, avoid bouncing, stretch after classes, and incorporate stretching 2-3 times a week.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided online resources and videos for stretching, including:  
- Websites: DanceBody (dancebody.com), Flexibility exercises by DanceWithMe (dancewithme.com).  
- YouTube Channels: Blogilates (youtube.com/blogilates), DanceTutorialsLive (youtube.com/dancetutorialslive), Stretching Exercises by Fitness Blender (youtube.com/fitnessblender).  
- Specific Videos: "How to Do the Splits" by Blogilates, "Dance Flexibility Stretches" by DanceTutorialsLive, "Split Stretching Exercises for Dancers" by Flexibility Exercises by DanceWithMe.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in getting a new pair of dance shoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on what to look for when buying dance shoes, including types of shoes (ballet, jazz, tap, ballroom), key features (fit, support, grip and slide, materials, weight), and general tips for buying.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended brands for dance shoes: Bloch, Capezio, So Danca, Grishko.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on how to take care of dance shoes to make them last longer, including:  
- Cleaning: wipe down after each use, use a gentle cleaning solution, avoid harsh chemicals.  
- Storage: store in a cool, dry place, use a shoe bag or box, keep away from direct sunlight.  
- Conditioning: use a leather conditioner, apply a waterproofing spray, condition the sole.  
- General Tips: avoid wearing the same shoes every day, check for wear and tear, dry shoes slowly.
